title: Insulin Pump Program Infusion-Set Refill Quantity Sheet
content:
**Item.** An infusion-set refill on an Insulin Pump Program ships A4224 infusion catheter supplies. The sets shipped on an infusion-set refill are worked out from the program's records and the customer's pump insulin records as follows.

## Clauses

1. **Supply days.** For an infusion-set refill, and only for such a refill, the supply days are the set refill's 30-day blocks times 30; a cartridge or reservoir refill keeps the supply days its own refill rule sets, and every other refill of the program keeps the general supply-days rule.
2. **Standard set refill period.** The standard set refill period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30, giving the set refill's 30-day blocks.
3. **Standard set rate.** The standard set rate is the standard sets per 30 days, 10 sets.
4. **Pump insulin.** The customer's pump insulin is the insulin dispensed under the customer's active insulin pharmacy program whose delivery method is insulin pump, counted in the standard way from its J1817 dispensing, each billing unit holding 50 units of insulin (the pump insulin unit insulin).
5. **Daily pump insulin.** The daily pump insulin is, in the standard way, the pump insulin dispensed in the three months before the ship date divided by the supply days those dispensings cover, and zero when nothing was dispensed in that time.
6. **Cartridge fill.** The cartridge fill for a set refill is the Mobi fill of 200 units of insulin for a Tandem Mobi, the iLet fill of 160 units for a Beta Bionics iLet and the standard fill of 300 units for every other model.
7. **Month windows.** A dispensing or a written order counts as in the three or six months before the ship date when its date is later than the same day of the month three or six months before the ship date, and a record counts as in any other number of months before the ship date when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before the ship date.
8. **Standard computation.** In the standard computation the set refill ships the standard set rate times the standard set refill period's 30-day blocks and bills one A4224 unit for every seven days of supply (the tier's days of supply per A4224 unit), rounded up.
9. **Combination.** Any adjustment to these standard figures changes the standard figure it names, replacements before additions; the sets shipped are then the set rate times the set refill's 30-day blocks plus any sets an adjustment adds, and the billing units remain one A4224 unit for every seven days of supply, rounded up.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical tiers)

- **Tier shipping 90 days per shipment:** 90 divided by 30 is 3 blocks; 10 multiplied by 3 is 30 infusion sets for 90 supply days; 90 divided by seven is 12.86, rounded up to 13 A4224 units.
- **Tier shipping 30 days per shipment:** 1 block; 10 infusion sets for 30 supply days; 30 divided by seven is 4.29, rounded up to 5 A4224 units.

*Window reading (hypothetical):* with a ship date of 20 May, a dispensing dated 21 February is in the three months before the ship date; one dated 20 February is not.
